fact: In April 2024 ARTAC reported only two of 213 planned operator interconnections for CEMAC free roaming were operational, including MTN Cameroon with MTN Congo and Airtel Gabon with Orange Cameroun; on 13 June 2026 CEMAC ministers recommended formal notices to laggards.
title: CEMAC : les opérateurs « récalcitrants » au free roaming menacés de mise en demeure
